power.title: Power Analysis Check
report:
::: {.callout-tip title="Learn More" collapse="true"}

Power analyses need to contain the following information to be interpretable: the type of power analysis, the statistical test, the software used, sample size, critical alpha criterion, power level, effect size, and an effect size metric. In addition, it is recommended to make sure the power analysis is reproducible (by sharing the code, or a screenshot, of the power analysis), and to provide good arguments for why the study was designed to detect an effect of this size.

For an a-priori power analysis, where the sample size is determined, reporting all information would look like:

> An a priori power analysis for an independent samples t-test, conducted using the pwr.t.test function from pwr (Champely, 2020), indicated that for a Cohen's d = 0.5, an alpha level of 0.05, and a desired power level of 80% required at least 64 participants in each group.

For a sensitivity power analysis, this sentence would look like:

> A sensitivity power analysis for an independent samples t-test, conducted using the pwr.t.test function from pwr (Champely, 2020), indicated that with 64 participants in each group, and an alpha level of 0.05, a desired power level of 80% was reached for an effect size of d = 0.5.

:::

text.text: The Challenge, HallucinaDon, Imagery, and Motor SuggesDon Scale (CHIMSS) is a novel set of imaginaDve suggesDons that each demand the uDlisaDon of phenomenological control.

This scale consists of three suggesDons of each type: motor suggesDons for arm levitaDon, hands coming together, and head nodding; challenge suggesDons for hands stuck together, fingers stuck together, and arm immobilisaDon; imagery involvement suggesDons for a beach scene, an animal-idenDficaDon scene, and a future scene; and hallucinaDon suggesDons for a mosquito, two tastes, and hearing a song playing automaDcally.
The scale notably excludes suggesDons for amnesia, post-hypnoDc behaviour, and visual hallucinaDons.

It also includes three alternaDve imagery involvement suggesDons that can be used in place of the exisDng ones or in addiDon: a meadow scene, a woods scene, and a scene involving idenDficaDon with a celesDal being or superhero.
The introducDon script and suggesDons were modified from the Phenomenological Control Scale (Lush et al., 2021).

You will shortly be given some exercises in the use of your imaginaDon to create certain experiences.
The aim is to see how much you can control the way you experience some simple events, such as moving your hand.
For example, you may be asked to lower your hand, and imagine it is being pulled down by itself.
Engage yourself in that imaginaDon, unDl it really feels like it is being pulled down by itself.
Focus on the sensaDons and on the imaginary situaDon so you can immerse yourself in that reality, as if, for example, you were ge]ng carried away by the narraDve of a film, as if it were real.
AUerwards, I will ask you to rate how strong you felt each experience; for example, how much the arm seemed to move by itself.
Your results on these exercises depend upon your willingness to try to imagine and to visualize the things I will ask you to imagine.
What I ask is your cooperaDon in helping this experiment by trying to imagine vividly what I describe to you.
Now, please seat yourself comfortably and rest your hands in your lap.
That's right.

Now your right hand should be in your lap.
I want you now to think about your right arm and hand.
Pay close acenDon to them.

Imagine that something is Ded to your wrist, puling it upwards… maybe a rope that is being pulled upwards through a hole in the ceiling -making the arm feel lighter… Now the hand and arm feel light, as if they are being pulled upwards… and as it feels lighter and lighter the hand and arm begin to move upwards… as if pulled up… moving… up, up, more and more up… lighter and lighter… the arm is rising effortlessly… up… slowly but surely… up, up, more and more up… the arm is so light, it rises so easily… You feel it becoming lighter and lighter… the arm is too light to hold down… it goes up, up, more and more up.
Allow 10 seconds.
That's good... now let your hand go back to its original resDng posiDon.
Your hand and arm are now as they were, feeling perfectly normal.
Now extend your arms straight out ahead of you, with the palms pressed together.
I want you now to think about your hands.
Pay close acenDon to them.
They are beginning to sDck together … NoDce that sensaDon as your hands begin to sDck … Your hands are beginning to sDck together … Tighter and Dghter … More and more stuck.

You might like to find out a licle later how sDcky your hands are … they seem too stuck to separate them … but in spite of how stuck they are, maybe you can move them a licle; but maybe they are too stuck for that … What if the palms of your hands were itchy?
So incredibly itchy you'd have to scratch them… but your hands are stuck together and you can't separate them.
Try now… try to separate your hands and scratch your palms if you need to, just try.
Allow 10 seconds.
That's fine.
Now place your hands back in their resDng posiDons.
Your hands and arms now feel normal again.
They are no longer sDcky or stuck.
They are no longer itchy.
And now something very interesDng is going to happen...
It is possible to hear my voice with one part of your mind... and with another part of your mind... to find that you will feel as if you are in a different place...
Soon you will find that you can feel as if you are no longer in this room and instead you will experience being on a beauDful beach...
And when this occurs, you will be able to see everything there...
You will experience every sight... sound, smell... and feeling on this beach...
When this occurs you will find that... you feel as if you are no longer in the current room and instead you will, experience being on a beach experiencing everything there...

Taking the path now...

Good.

And now something interesDng is starDng to happen.
While you are si]ng here, listening to my voice, with your eyes closed, you will begin to noDce that you are starDng to transform into an animal.

Taste Hallucina+on I want you to think of something sweet in your mouth.
Imagine that you have something sweet-tasDng in your mouth, like a licle sugar... and as you think about this sweet taste you can actually begin to experience the sweet taste...
